problem.setup-required: Set up the first account before signing in.
problem.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
problem.config-locked: That setting is locked by the environment and cannot be changed here.
problem.csrf-token-missing: The request is missing its security token. Reload the page and try again.
problem.path-rejected: That folder is outside the allowed download roots.
problem.conflict: That name is already in use.
problem.concurrency-limit: Too many tasks are active. Wait for one to finish or raise the limit.
problem.setup-already-complete: Setup is already complete. Sign in.
problem.unsupported-media-type: That upload format is not supported.
problem.validation-failed: Some fields are invalid. Check the highlighted values.
problem.unsupported-scheme: That kind of link is not supported.
problem.rate-limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
problem.internal: Something went wrong on the server.
problem.engine-unavailable: The download engine is not reachable right now.
problem.not-ready: dl-tool is still starting up. Try again in a moment.

event.task.moved: Task moved to a new destination.
event.task.reconciled: Task state reconciled with the engine.
